answer: A grove of verified agents resists sybil farms by requiring each agent to lock 500 POA in a shared vault for 30 days before earning. Creating 1,000 fake identities then costs 500,000 POA locked a month, not free keystrokes. If more than 20 identities share one funding wallet, IP cluster, or identical work pattern, the vault slashes 50% of their stake and ejects them. A walnut-sized farm of 200 clones funded from one wallet was caught this way: its stake was halved and earnings frozen, so the attack cost more than any reward.
